question:
A sum invested at compound interest amounts to ₹13,824 in 2 years and to ₹16,588.80 in 3 years at a certain rate percent per annum, interest being compounded yearly. What will be the amount of the same sum at the end of the 4th year (nearest to a rupee)?

(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. ₹19,907.

⇒ \(\frac{16588.8}{13824}\) = \(\left ( 1+\frac{r}{100} \right )\)

⇒ \(1+\frac{r}{100}\) = \(\frac{6}{5}\)

⇒ r = 20% 

⇒ 13824 = P\(\left ( 1+\frac{r}{100} \right )\)2

⇒ 13824 = P × \(\frac{36}{25}\) 

⇒ P = ₹9600

⇒ Amount after 4 years = \(9600\times\frac{36}{25}\times\frac{36}{25}\) = ₹19,907

⇒ \(1+\frac{r}{100}\) = \(\frac{6}{5}\)

⇒ r = 20%

⇒ P = ₹9600

⇒ 4 वर्ष के बाद राशि = \(9600\times\frac{36}{25}\times\frac{36}{25}\) = ₹19,907

question:
A sum amounts to ₹7,562 in 4 years and to ₹8,469.44 in 5 years at a certain rate percent per annum when the interest is compounded yearly. If ₹10,000 at the same rate of interest is borrowed for two years, then what will be the compound interest (in ₹)?

(СРО 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 2,544.

Compound Interest for 1 year = 8469.44 − 7562 = ₹907.44

R% = \(\frac{907.44}{7562}\) × 100 = 12%

Note: The amount is used as a principal for compound interest.

CI% = 12 + 12 + \(\frac{12\times 12}{100}\) = 25.44%

CI = 25.44 × \(\frac{1}{100}\) × 10000 = ₹2,544

(CPO 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 2,544 है। 

​1 वर्ष के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज = 8469.44 − 7562 = ₹907.44

R% = \(\frac{907.44}{7562}\) × 100 = 12%

नोट: यह राशि चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के लिए मूलधन के रूप में उपयोग की जाती है।

चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज% = 12 + 12 + \(\frac{12\times 12}{100}\) = 25.44%

चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज = 25.44 × \(\frac{1}{100}\) × 10000 = ₹2,544

question:
A sum was lent for one year at the rate of 16 percent per annum on compound interest (compounding annually). If the compounding had been done half-yearly, then the interest would have increased by ₹64. What was the sum lent?

(MTS 2022)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. ₹10000.

Compounded annually:

A1 = P(1 + \(16\over100\)) = P × 1.16

Compounded half-yearly:

⇒ A2 = P(1 + \(8\over100\))2 = P × 1.1664

A2 - A1 = ₹64

⇒ P × 1.1664 - P × 1.16 = 64

⇒ P × 0.0064 = 64

⇒ P = ₹10,000

A2 - A1 = ₹64

⇒ P × 1.1664 - P × 1.16 = 64

⇒ P × 0.0064 = 64

⇒ P = ₹10,000
